skill.name: moderncv-resume
skill.description: Write, design and export a professional resume with ModernCV (89 templates, vector PDF, free, no account). Use when the user asks to create, rewrite, tailor, format or export a resume or CV, or wants a resume PDF for a job application.
skill.summary: Draft factual resumes and academic CVs, preview layouts, and export PDF or LaTeX through the ModernCV service.
skill.author: digidai

security_audit.summary: All 38 static findings are false positives: Markdown backticks, documented service integrations, and API options do not establish execution abuse or reconnaissance. One semantic privacy concern remains: mandatory editor-link creation embeds personal resume data in a shareable URL without an explicit consent step. No evidence found of malicious exfiltration, prompt injection, or credential theft.

remediation.issue: The delivery workflow always creates a resume-bearing editor link without checking whether the user wants personal data embedded in a URL.
remediation.suggestion: Make editor links optional and request consent before creation. Explain that link holders can access the resume, and omit sensitive details when possible.

semantic_findings.title: Mandatory Editor Links Carry Personal Resume Data
semantic_findings.description: The workflow says 'always' create an editor link. Privacy documentation states that its URL fragment contains the resume, exposing personal data to link holders. No explicit consent step precedes creation.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The unconditional link instruction and resume-bearing fragment are explicit. Fragment handling limits server transmission but does not prevent access by someone possessing the link.

content.user_title: Create and Export Resumes with ModernCV
content.value_statement: Turning career history into a clear resume requires careful writing and consistent formatting. This skill guides factual drafting and uses ModernCV for previews and exports.
actual_capabilities: Draft structured resumes from supplied facts and tailor wording to a shared job posting without inventing employment details.
Retrieve role-specific writing guides, example resumes, and template metadata through MCP tools or HTTP endpoints.
Request first-page PNG previews, inspect page counts, and adjust template selection or scale using rendering warnings.
Request selectable-text PDF exports in A4 or US Letter format and generate preloaded editor links.
Import publications from ORCID or BibTeX and organize academic CV sections supported by the selected template.
Map existing LaTeX CV content into the resume structure and request LaTeX exports for optional Overleaf import.
limitations: Previewing and exporting depend on an external ModernCV service; rendering can encounter rate limits or temporary failures.
The package contains instructions only, without bundled rendering software or independently verified service privacy guarantees.
Preview output shows only the first page, so longer PDFs require additional review.
ATS-friendly labels do not guarantee hiring-system compatibility, and users must verify facts and control sharing of resume-bearing links.

use_cases.title: Tailor an Application Resume
use_cases.description: Turn verified work history and a job posting into targeted bullets, an appropriate template, and a reviewed PDF.

use_cases.title: Organize an Academic CV
use_cases.description: Select publications from ORCID or BibTeX and combine them with awards, teaching, and talks in a compatible CV template.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Federal Resume
use_cases.description: Arrange supplied hours, month-level dates, credentials, and role details using the federal template and its page-count warnings.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a First Resume
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me draft a resume for [job title] using [career history]. Ask for missing facts and do not invent achievements. Keep the draft local.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create a factual first draft.

prompt_templates.title: Tailor a Resume to a Posting
prompt_templates.prompt: Tailor [resume] to [job posting] using only verified facts. Recommend an ATS-friendly template. Ask before uploading data or creating editor links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: adapt an existing resume for a specific role.

prompt_templates.title: Preview and Export a One-Page PDF
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [approved resume] to request a ModernCV preview in US Letter format. Adjust layout using warnings, then export PDF. Do not create editor links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: use the external service to refine pagination and export.

prompt_templates.title: Convert an Academic LaTeX CV
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert [LaTeX CV] while preserving every fact. Select publications from [BibTeX] with my approval. Ask before external uploads, then request PDF and LaTeX exports.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: combine document conversion, publication selection, and multiple export formats.

output_examples.input: Draft a data analyst resume from verified notes showing a 20 percent reduction in monthly reporting time.
output: Experience bullet: Automated monthly reporting and reduced preparation time by 20 percent.
Review note: Confirm the employer, dates, and automation tools before export.
Layout recommendation: Choose an ATS-friendly template and inspect page-count warnings.

output_examples.input: Plan an academic CV using a supplied BibTeX bibliography, teaching history, and award records.
output: Proposed sections: Profile, Education, Research Experience, Publications, Teaching, and Awards.
Publication review: Ask which bibliography entries to include and confirm author order.
Export plan: Select a publications-compatible template, review the complete PDF, and request LaTeX if needed.

best_practices: Confirm dates, employers, degrees, and achievement metrics before drafting or exporting.
Approve external processing and editor-link creation separately; remove unnecessary personal details before sharing.
Use template metadata and rendering warnings, then inspect every exported page.
anti_patterns: Copying employers, dates, or achievement numbers from example resumes into a real application.
Treating editor links or download links as private documents that can be shared without review.
Assuming a first-page preview or ATS-friendly template label guarantees a complete, compatible application.

faq.question: Does this skill require an account or API key?
faq.answer: The skill documents ModernCV access without an account or API key. A connected MCP server is optional because HTTP endpoints are also described.

faq.question: Can it generate PDF and LaTeX files?
faq.answer: It documents external endpoints for selectable-text PDF and LaTeX exports. Successful output depends on service availability and valid resume data.

faq.question: Can it import an existing resume?
faq.answer: It accepts the documented native structure and JSON Resume format. LaTeX CVs require the assistant to map their contents into that structure.

faq.question: Can it create an academic CV?
faq.answer: It documents ORCID and BibTeX publication imports plus awards, teaching, and talks. Choose a template that supports the required sections.

faq.question: Where is resume data processed?
faq.answer: Rendering requests send resume data to ModernCV. The skill claims temporary processing, but this audit cannot verify server behavior. Editor links contain resume data.

faq.question: Does an ATS-friendly template guarantee acceptance?
faq.answer: No. Template metadata helps selection but does not guarantee compatibility or hiring outcomes. Verify the final PDF against the application requirements.
